summary.text: JOH. JØRG. BACKE CC VEST AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2013-10-25. JOH. JØRG. BACKE CC VEST AS engages in retail sale of kitchen equipment, glassware and stoneware. Its main industry code is 47.553: retail sale of household utensils, cutlery, crockery, glassware, tableware, china and pottery. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 10 783 624 NOK and the annual result was -464 364 NOK; operating income was up from 10 470 629 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 276 647 NOK in 2024 to -464 364 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 1 979 390 NOK in 2024 to 1 323 201 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Kjell Olav Evers Solheim (daglig leder and styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 22 on 2025-12-13 to 14 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
